mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a -5% YoY drop in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, as measured by the month-over-month change in UNRATE, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises by > 2 points in the month following the UNRATE trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and falling real savings rate (RSAFS) signals overextended consumers that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real consumer spending (PCE) grows by > 3% YoY in the quarter following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals a tightening of financial conditions that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a flattening of the yield curve to < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims (ICSA) fall by > 10% in the month following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals an inflation shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a > 0.5% MoM rise in CPI.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM Manufacturing PMI rises above 50 in the quarter following the signal.
